content-body" data-testid="RDMD"><p>Welcome to Eversend API Reference documentation! We're always working hard to improve the experience for our developers - because we know you want to get things working as quickly and smoothly as possible.</p>
<h2 class="heading heading-2 header-scroll" align=""><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="-make-api-requests-straight-from-the-documentation"></div><div class="heading-text"><div id="section-👨‍💻-make-api-requests-straight-from-the-documentation" class="heading-anchor_backwardsCompatibility"></div>👨‍💻 Make API requests straight from the documentation</div><a aria-label="Skip link to 👨‍💻 Make API requests straight from the documentation" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-anchor" href="#-make-api-requests-straight-from-the-documentation"></a></h2>
<p>Just add your clientId and clientSecret keys from the settings page of your business account, select the right environment, and fill in the details for your call! All the required fields are automatically highlighted for you in red and there's automatic data validation so you'll always know exactly what parameters you need to provide.</p>
<blockquote class="callout callout_okay" theme="👍"><h2 class="callout-heading"><span class="callout-icon">👍</span><p>Auto-filled cURL requests</p></h2><p>When you test our API using cURL, our API reference will automatically construct the right payload for you!</p></blockquote>
<h2 class="heading heading-2 header-scroll" align=""><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="-see-eversend-sdk-examples"></div><div class="heading-text"><div id="section-🔍-see-eversend-sdk-examples" class="heading-anchor_backwardsCompatibility"></div>🔍 See Eversend SDK examples</div><a aria-label="Skip link to 🔍 See Eversend SDK examples" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-anchor" href="#-see-eversend-sdk-examples"></a></h2>
<p>For all our API calls, you can see examples of our SDKs. Just click on the Node, Python, or PHP icon, and see an example call!</p>
<p>Additionally, you can also see auto-generated code examples for the most popular languages.</p>
<h2 class="heading heading-2 header-scroll" align=""><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="-view-the-response-schema-and-examples"></div><div class="heading-text"><div id="section-📃-view-the-response-schema-and-examples" class="heading-anchor_backwardsCompatibility"></div>📃 View the response schema and examples</div><a aria-label="Skip link to 📃 View the response schema and examples" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-anchor" href="#-view-the-response-schema-and-examples"></a></h2>
<p>To view the response schema, just click on the response type in the Responses section of the call. What's more - we've included sample responses for most endpoints!</p>
